method.direct_views: Each distinct payload representative was displayed through tools.view_image with detail original and visually inspected by the attributed reviewer.
method.exact_repeats: Every repeated source identity retains its own packet metadata and is bound by independent raw-byte equality plus SHA-256 and length checks to a directly inspected identity from the same recording.
method.observation_reuse: Only exact-byte payload repeats share the direct representative's observation. Distinct payloads were each directly inspected even when visually similar.
method.clock_scope: Original MP4 packet PTS and time base only. No host UTC/action alignment is inferred from these values.

conclusion: No private card face was observed in any of the 69 represented source-frame identities. The compact split-pane table shows public content and a Show hand control without visible hand cards or 3D geometry. Opaque closing covers are followed by a wide standard table whose concealed-hand panel is visible.

limits: Review covers only the retained source frames of the two assigned original recordings. Full retained-frame coverage does not establish behavior between captured frames or in other runs.
Packet PTS/DTS and time base are media coordinates. No UTC, host-action, input-down/up, lifecycle-event, or other clock alignment is inferred.
No continuous privacy or concealment-before-action guarantee is claimed. Opaque-cover and hand observations refer only to the represented frame pixels.

Pixel visibility, clipping, scrollbars, control labels and button tone do not establish interaction reachability, scrolling behavior, enabled state, touch-target dimensions in dp, or accessibility semantics.
No new original-video decoding, captures, builds, downloads, device interaction, physical-network tests, or shared repository mutations were performed.
Recording identity and style assignment come from pinned source manifests. A compact frame without 3D geometry cannot by itself qualify the real 3D renderer.
At source indices 42 through 54, no hand cards or 3D table geometry are visible in the compact table pane. Show hand is visible, but no conclusion about offscreen card pixels follows from that label.
